old_caption: The video opens with an aerial view of a cityscape enveloped in dense fog. The scene is dominated by a thick layer of mist that obscures much of the urban environment below. In the background, several tall buildings stand out against the hazy backdrop, their silhouettes barely visible through the fog. The foreground features a mix of greenery and lower-rise structures, which are also partially hidden by the fog. The fog appears to be moving slightly, creating a dynamic and ever-changing atmosphere. The overall mood is one of mystery and tranquility, as the viewer is drawn into the serene yet enigmatic world created by the fog.

In the background, several tall buildings stand out against the hazy backdrop, their silhouettes barely visible through the fog. The foreground features a mix of greenery and lower-rise structures, which are also partially hidden by the fog. As the video progresses, the camera slowly pans across the scene, revealing more details of the city's layout and the interplay between the built environment and the natural elements. The fog appears to be moving slightly, creating a dynamic and ever-changing atmosphere. The overall mood is one of mystery and tranquility, as the viewer is drawn into the serene yet enigmatic world created by the fog.
caption: A high-angle aerial view shows a city lit by warm orange sun on the right and cool teal shadow on the left. A fixed skyline lines the left edge: a cylindrical-topped tower, a striped slab building, and distant blocks fading behind haze. The center and right are dominated by a thick billowing cloud that partly swallows low rooftops, including a flat-roofed building in the lower-center. Within the frame, the illuminated cloud mass continuously billows and reshapes, its orange highlights and internal swirls shifting position from moment to moment. A darker greenish plume in the left-center billows and shifts, changing its silhouette against the buildings and brighter cloud. The cloud boundary over the lower-center rooftop advances and retreats, alternately obscuring and revealing the flat roof and its small structure. The overall cloud gradually spreads leftward across the frame, while the left skyline holds its position throughout.
